patterns.what: intro: HERE COMES thrown into the echo; dub chords, the FILTER opening; a LOOP 1/8
groove: the beat, DUCK pumping, the 303 bubbling, the bell; the FILTER closing into the break
break: the pad on the progression, the bell into a REVERB SWELL; the kick coming back
build: GATE, then the FILTER rising; a roll, THREE TWO ONE, a TAPE STOP
peak: everything; a LOOP 1/16, the bell, a BIT CRUSH, a REVERSE at the end
outro: the full beat to the end, a STUTTER, the bell; a VINYL STOP cuts it
